text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy hasn't shown up for<n>training.
Worried, I begin searching for<n>her when...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's you! Great timing! Ta-daaah!<n>Look at this!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Whatcha think? Isn't Shishimai all<n>shiny and
sparklin'? I spent hours<n>polishin' them up!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! I totally forgot about that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I warn Shinko Windy to not get so<n>absorbed in
things that she misses<n>her training.
